checks.name: Study ID, lead sponsor, status and type are present on every study
Pipeline studies with a start date
checks.note: Older records and withdrawn studies often have none. Studies without a start date are left out of start-year counts, never given a made-up year.

checks.name: Active pipeline studies with a primary completion date
checks.note: Without a date a study cannot appear in the readouts-due view.

checks.name: Pipeline studies with a registry MeSH condition term
checks.note: The rest are mostly healthy-volunteer Phase 1 studies. Area comes from the condition text, then MeSH, then the molecule (see C15).

checks.name: Study IDs look like NCT plus 8 digits
Every date the registry gives can be read
checks.note: Dates come as a day, a month or a year; a month is stored as the first of the month and flagged.

checks.name: Start is not after primary completion when both are ACTUAL
checks.note: Kept and flagged, left out of timing measures if any appear.

checks.name: Status and phase are values the model knows
Pipeline enrollment is between 0 and 100,000
checks.note: 98 studies outside the pipeline exceed 100,000: observational database studies (one covers 188 million people). They are real, not errors, and are not drug-development studies.

checks.name: One row per study
checks.note: The same study is found by several searches (Merck and MSD); it is kept once.

checks.name: One row per study and country
Studies loaded per search equal the total the API announced
checks.note: 37,564 study rows over 44 searches; API data as of 2026-10-14T09:00:05 (unchanged at the end of the download).

checks.name: Every distinct study fetched is in scope or quarantined with a reason
checks.note: Nothing is dropped silently.

checks.name: MSD study count equals a fresh count from the API
checks.result: 2,189 in the warehouse; live API not asked
checks.rule: equal on the same data date
checks.note: Run without --offline to compare against the live API.

checks.name: Active pipeline studies assigned a therapeutic area
checks.note: Text first, then MeSH, then the molecule's usual area. What no step can place stays Unclassified, never spread across other areas.

checks.name: Active pipeline studies with a molecule key
checks.note: Placebo, saline, standard of care and similar comparators are not counted as molecules.

checks.name: Merck products in Rx Market Pulse with at least one MSD study
checks.note: All 14 families match by molecule name, MK development code or brand name.

checks.name: Condition text and registry MeSH terms agree on the area
checks.note: The registry's MeSH matching is automatic: a lung-cancer study that mentions PD-L1 is also tagged with a Parkinson disease term. Text wins, so those disagreements do not change the area.

checks.name: Stopped pipeline studies whose reason fits a theme
checks.note: The reason is free text and often reads 'see detailed description'. It is mapped by rules, so treat the themes as indicative.

checks.name: No sponsor name that mentions a company falls through the rules
checks.note: The search is full-text, so names such as 'University of Bristol' come back for 'Bristol'. Each is set aside by an explicit rule; a name that mentions a company and matches no rule is a failure.

checks.name: Merck KGaA is never counted as MSD
checks.result: 0 in the MSD group; 348 Merck KGaA studies set aside
checks.note: Same name, different company: Merck KGaA of Darmstadt owns the name outside the US and Canada.

checks.name: Studies MSD gains from the roll-up of acquired companies
checks.note: Cubist, Acceleron, Verona, Prometheus, ArQule and others, under their current owner as of October 2026. Divested or spun-off units (Organon, Alcon, Sandoz) are excluded, not reassigned.

checks.name: Every country spelling maps to an ISO code
checks.note: Spellings such as 'Turkey (Türkiye)' and 'Korea, Republic of' are mapped in data/ref/countries.csv.

checks.name: Age of the data snapshot at build time
checks.note: The snapshot is frozen on purpose so every number on the site and the CV agree.

checks.name: Active studies verified in the last 12 months
checks.result: 2,326 of 2,416; 67 are overdue (estimated primary completion already passed)
checks.note: An overdue study still says it will finish in a month that has gone: the forecast was not updated.
